data.name: MasterKeyBlock1Heading
data.value: Master key introduction

data.name: MasterKeyBlock1Text1
data.value: Master key is a feature which enables business administrators to recover files of the business members.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock1Text2
data.value: Imagine an important financial document being encrypted after creating the yearly revenue report. During the following year a new financial team is put in place, and when it's time for the yearly report they realize the financial document the previous team used, is now encrypted with credentials no one has access to any longer.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock1Text3
data.value: Enter Master key! With Master key enabled, the administrators of the business can always recover any file encrypted by the business members. In the above case the new financial team just has to ask their administrator and the financial document can easily be recovered, even if the original user left the company.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock1Text4
data.value: As long as the business has one or a couple administrators who make sure to keep track of their credentials, no files will ever be lost due to employees leaving or forgetting their passwords.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock2Heading
data.value: Master key and security

data.name: MasterKeyBlock2Text1
data.value: When enabling master key, business administrators can recover any document encrypted by their members. This, as mentioned, eliminates the risk of losing access to critical files. But is it secure?

data.name: MasterKeyBlock2Text2
data.value: In terms of security, you can view Master key as an automatic sharing of files with the administrators of the business. Administrators will automatically be able to recover files which has their Master key applied. This is no less secure than simply using AxCrypt's tried and tested Key Sharing feature.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock2Text3
data.value: Of course, business administrators need to be extra careful to choose good passwords and keeping their account safe at all times.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock3Heading
data.value: Enabling master key

data.name: MasterKeyBlock3Text1
data.value: Master key can be enabled from the manage subscription page.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock3Text2
data.value: After enabling Master key, all existing member of the business have to approve the change. This is an important security consideration, an existing user should never feel like this feature was hidden from them. Who has accepted the Master key feature can be seen in the user table.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock3Text3
data.value: If a user has not accepted Master key, it will not be applied to files they encrypt, so make sure everyone in your business accepts the feature.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock3Text4
data.value: Note! Files encrypted before enabling Master key will of course not be possible to recover. Old files have to be re-encrypted after the user having accepted master key.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock3Text5
data.value: For new businesses, or new members of existing businesses, Master key will be automatically approved when members joins the business.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Heading
data.value: Using Master Key

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text1
data.value: Once Master key has been enabled, it will be automatically applied to all files encrypted by members of the business. You can see if Master key has been applied by the Master key icon shown in the application.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text2
data.value: If a file has this icon, then any business administrator can recover the file.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text3
data.value: That's it! As you can see, Master key is very easy to use and nothing your business member ever have to consider or spend time on.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text4
data.value: Please note that even though business administrators can recover files using Master key, this should not be used in normal usage. If a file is intended to be opened by a business administrator, then the file should Key shared with that user, just as with any other user.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text5
data.value: Files encrypted before enabling Master key will of course not be possible to recover. Old files must be re-encrypted after the user having accepted master key.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text6
data.value: After Master Key enabled, sign out If already signed in and sign in back to the AxCrypt Application. An information message popup will appear to inform about the master key enabled.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text7
data.value: You can see if Master key has been applied by the Master key icon shown in the application. If a file has this icon, then any group administrator can recover the file.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock4Text8
data.value: That's it! As you can see, Master key is very easy to use and nothing your business member ever must consider or spend time on.

data.name: MasterKeyBlock5Heading
data.value: Need more help?

data.name: MasterKeyBlock5Text1
data.value: Our priority business support is always standing by to help with any questions or concerns. Use the form on your account page, or send us a mail at business@axcrypt.net and we'll help you out!

data.name: MasterKeyBlock5Text2
data.value: Please note that while Group Administrators or Master Key Owners can recover files using the Master Key, this functionality should not be relied upon for regular usage. If a file is intended to be opened by a group administrator, it should be key shared with that user, just like with any non-admin user.

data.name: MasterKeyGuideBlock2Heading
data.value: Who is Master Key Owner?

data.name: MasterKeyGuideBlock2Text1
data.value: A Master Key Owner holds special rights to recover any file encrypted by all Group’s members when Master Key is enabled, even not being a member of the group.

data.name: MasterKeyGuideBlock2Text2
data.value: Only one Business Administrator can be a Master Key Owner. A new Master Key Owner can be assigned only by the current Master Key Owner, by selecting from the Business Administrators list.

data.name: MasterKeyGuideBlock2Text3
data.value: Also, Master Key Owner can enable/disable the group’s master key. A Master Key Owner can recover any files encrypted by the group members when group administrator lost master key access.

data.name: MasterKeyGuideBlock3Text3

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq1
data.value: Can I use multiple MFA methods at once?

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq1Ans
data.value: Yes, AxCrypt supports enabling all primary MFA method at a time (Authenticator App, Email or SMS). However, you can select between them at the time of login.

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq2
data.value: What if I uninstall my Authenticator App?

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq2Ans
data.value: If you uninstall your authenticator app or reset your phone, you’ll need to use a backup code or a secondary verification method (like email/SMS if enabled) to log in. Without those, recovery may require you to contact AxCrypt Support for identity verification.

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq3
data.value: Can I use MFA while offline?

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq3Ans
data.value: Yes, if you're using an authenticator app, it works without an internet connection. However, SMS and email-based MFA require an internet or mobile network to receive the verification code.

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq4
data.value: Can I access my files if I’m locked out due to MFA issues?

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq4Ans
data.value: Your files remain encrypted and safe. However, without account access, you won’t be able to decrypt or manage them via AxCrypt. This is why storing backup codes is crucial.

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq5
data.value: Is my MFA data secure?

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq5Ans
data.value: Absolutely. AxCrypt adheres to GDPR and NIS2 compliance. MFA-related data is processed securely and stored in AxCrypt servers in encrypted format and only users can decrypt it.

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq6
data.value: Is MFA available to all users?

data.name: MFAuthenticationFaq6Ans
data.value: Yes, MFA is available for Free, Premium, and Business users.

data.name: MFAuthenticationGuideNote
data.value: Once multi-factor authentication is enabled, AxCrypt will prompt you for a one-time verification code whenever you log in, adding an extra layer of security for your account.

data.name: MFAuthenticationLinkLable
data.value: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec1Heading
data.value: What is Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)?

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec1Paragraph1
data.value: Passwords alone are not always enough to secure your sensitive data. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enhances security by requiring a second verification step, ensuring that only authorized users can access their accounts.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec1Paragraph2
data.value:
With MFA enabled, logging in requires both your password and a one-time code generated on your authenticator app or sent to your email or mobile device. This extra layer of protection significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access, even if your password is compromised.

MFA is an essential security measure that helps keep your encrypted files safe, making AxCrypt even more reliable for personal and business use.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec1Paragraph3
data.value: Authenticator App: Use a Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) generated via registered Authenticator App.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec1Paragraph4
data.value: Email: Receive a secured verification code in your email.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec1Paragraph5
data.value: SMS: Get a one-time passcode via SMS.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec1Text1
data.value: Multiple Verification Option

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec2Heading
data.value: AxCrypt’s Multifactor Authentication (MFA) at a Glance

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec2SubHead1
data.value: Secure Login with Multiple Factors

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec2SubHead2
data.value: Encrypted Backup Codes for Emergency Access

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec2SubHead3
data.value: GDPR-Compliant Data Handling

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec2Text1
data.value: AxCrypt’s MFA requires users to verify their identity using two or more authentication factors—something they know (password) or something they have (authenticator app or code).

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec2Text2
data.value: During setup, users receive encrypted backup codes to ensure account access even if the primary device is lost. These should be securely stored by the user.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec2Text3
data.value: All MFA-related data is processed in accordance with GDPR and other applicable privacy standards, ensuring user data is safe and secure.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec3Heading
data.value: What If You Lose Access to All MFA Options?

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec3Paragraph
data.value: If you lose access to your MFA method and don’t have recovery codes or any other backup options (like SMS or email verification), account recovery becomes significantly more difficult and may require a manual identity verification process or contact AxCrypt Support for more help.

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec4Heading
data.value: How Are Recovery or Backup Codes useful?

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec4Paragraph1
data.value: After enabling MFA, download or copy your backup codes. Recovery or backup codes are a set of one-time-use codes provided when you first set up two-factor authentication (2FA). These codes act as a backup method to access your account if your primary 2FA method - such as an authenticator app is unavailable (e.g., lost phone, non-availability of SMS or email, app uninstalled, etc.).

data.name: MFAuthenticationSec4Paragraph2
data.value:
If you can't use your regular MFA method during login, you'll be prompted to enter one of your recovery codes. This bypasses the need for your usual authentication method and lets you access your account safely.

Each code can only be used once and should be stored securely.

data.name: PartnerFaq1
data.value: What is AxCrypt’s Partner Program?

data.name: PartnerFaq1Ans
data.value: AxCrypt’s Partner Program lets you earn money by promoting AxCrypt’s data encryption software. You earn a percentage of each sale amount.

data.name: PartnerFaq2
data.value: Who can join AxCrypt’s Partner Program?

data.name: PartnerFaq2Ans
data.value: We'd love to have anyone passionate about data and cybersecurity join our partner program. However, you'll earn more if you're an influencer with a substantial following, a blogger, a direct marketer with a substantial client base, run a business, or work in the press.

data.name: PartnerFaq3
data.value: Is there any cost of joining the program?

data.name: PartnerFaq3Ans
data.value: Absolutely not. Our partner program is free to join.

data.name: PartnerFaq4
data.value: How much can I earn?

data.name: PartnerFaq4Ans
data.value: The sky's the limit. You'll receive a percentage of the sale amount — so the more sales, the more money.

data.name: PartnerFaq5
data.value: What’s the difference between becoming an Affiliate and a Reseller?

data.name: PartnerFaq5Ans
data.value: They differ in how you sell the products and earn a commission. As an Affiliate, you receive a fixed amount of commission when you make a sale, while as a Reseller, you set your own final price for the customer and retain the rest of the amount as your commission.

data.name: PartnerFaq6
data.value: How can I promote AxCrypt’s product?

data.name: PartnerFaq6Ans
data.value: You can promote AxCrypt's product through various channels such as your website, blog, social media platforms, email newsletters, webinars, and online forums. Additionally, you can create compelling content like reviews, tutorials, and case studies to showcase the benefits of AxCrypt's data encryption software.

data.name: PasswordRulesInfo
data.value:
AxCrypt has a sophisticated password strength evaluator based on measuring the actual strength of the password. It must also be at least 8 effective characters long.
We evaluate the password by estimating the strength, which is based on how long and complex the password is.
The evaluation entirely disregards parts of the password that is recognized as being among the 1,000 most common passwords, as well as white space. For example the password 'secretX password Y 123456' is evaluated as just 'XY', since spaces, 'secret', 'password' and '123456' are ignored!
We classify the password in 4 categories of increasing strength, were we do not accept any password in the lowest category. The above example is not accepted for that reason.
data.comment: A text describing the rules for passwords for AxCrypt. Pure text. For HTML views, newlines must be replaced, and possibly wrap it with a CSS style.

data.name: PasswordRulesShortInfo
data.value:
AxCrypt uses an advanced dynamic password strength calculator.
White space, and parts that are equal to common passwords are ignored and do not add any strength.
data.comment: A shorter description of how password strength is evaluated.

data.name: PremiumFaq1
data.value: How does AxCrypt Premium protect my files?

data.name: PremiumFaq1Ans
data.value: AxCrypt Premium uses AES-256 encryption, a standard trusted by governments and security experts worldwide, ensuring your files are encrypted and protected from unauthorized access.

data.name: PremiumFaq2
data.value: Is AxCrypt Premium easy to use?

data.name: PremiumFaq2Ans
data.value: Yes! AxCrypt Premium is designed with simplicity in mind, allowing you to encrypt and protect your files with just a few clicks, without requiring any technical expertise.

data.name: PremiumFaq3
data.value: Is AxCrypt Premium suitable for my business?

data.name: PremiumFaq3Ans
data.value: No. AxCrypt Premium is designed specifically for individual users seeking robust encryption for personal use. For business needs, including team management and advanced security features, AxCrypt Business is the appropriate solution.

data.name: PremiumFaq4
data.value: Can I try AxCrypt Premium before committing?

data.name: PremiumFaq4Ans
data.value: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial for AxCrypt Premium. This allows you to explore all premium features and assess if it meets your needs. Sign up for the trial on our Free Trial Page.

data.name: PremiumFaq5
data.value: What if I forget my password?

data.name: PremiumFaq5Ans
data.value: If you forget your AxCrypt password, you can reset it, but you won’t be able to access data encrypted with the old one. So, be sure to keep your password safe and memorable. For added security and convenience, consider using our Password Generator to create strong passwords and our Password Manager to securely store and manage them. The Password Generator ensures your passwords are complex and unique, while the Password Manager helps you organize and retrieve them effortlessly.

data.name: PremiumFirstBodyHeading
data.value: AxCrypt Premium

data.name: PremiumFirstBodyText
data.value:
Interested in getting a subscription, but not sure if it fits your needs? You can enjoy 14 days of AxCrypt Premium for free.

With AxCrypt Premium, you have access to extended functionality and exciting features! Encrypt your files with AES-256 – the strongest of the AES algorithm. It is used globally to protect sensitive and classified information of all levels. Securing folders has never been easier, only taking a single click to automatically secure new files.

If you also need to share secured files with others, you will have key sharing to take care of that for you, even with access to cloud storage awareness in Dropbox, Google Drive and OneDrive etc. With the AxCrypt mobile app, you can encrypt and decrypt files on your phone, from anywhere and at any time.

Want to save password in a safe and easy way? Use our password management and generator to keep all your passwords safe in the cloud.

Try it out to discover all the features and benefits it offers!

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock10Heading
data.value: Sharing information

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock10Text1
data.value: We may share your information: With the public if you submit content to one of our forums, such as blog comments, social media posting, or other features of our services that are publicly visible; with third parties such as other sites that integrate with our API or our Services; or those with an API or service that we integrate with; Any necessary third party engaged by us, including data processors, vendors, consultants, marketing partners, and other service providers who need access to such information to perform work on our behalf; In response to an information request by a competent authority if we believe disclosure is under or otherwise required by applicable law, regulation, license or legal process; if we otherwise notify you and you consent to the sharing; and in an aggregate and / or anonymous form which cannot be reasonably expected to be used to identify you.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock11Text1
data.value: In addition to this website, we maintain social media sites on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn. If you visit one of these presences, personal data may be transmitted to the provider of the social network. We draw your attention to the fact that user data may be transferred to a server in a third-party country and may therefore be processed outside the European Union.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock11Text2
data.value: In addition to the storage of the specific data you have entered in this social medium, further information may also be processed by the provider of the social network. If you are logged into the network with your personal user account while visiting the corresponding website, this network can assign the visit to this account. The purpose and scope of the data collection by the respective medium and the further processing of your data there, as well as your rights in this regard, can be found in the respective provisions of the respective person responsible, e.g. below:

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock12Heading
data.value: Transfer of data to third parties

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock12Text1
data.value: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) - Hubspot HubSpot is an integrated software solution with which we cover various aspects of our online marketing activities, among contact management via the CRM system. The legal basis for the use of the services of HubSpot is our rightful interest according to art. 6 I f GDPR due to the optimization of our marketing measures and the improvement of our service quality on the website.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock12Text2
data.value: HubSpot meets the minimum requirements for legally compliant order data processing by concluding the European standard data protection clause. In addition, there is a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with HubSpot. This ensures that HubSpot uses the user’s data only within the framework of EU data protection standards and does not pass them on to third parties. For more information, please refer to HubSpot’s data privacy policy.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock1Text1
data.value: Our privacy policy, of course, complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). In this privacy policy, we mention what we know about you, what we do with the information and why we need it. You can always withdraw your consent and request us to delete your data. Visit our dedicated GDPR page, to learn more about the regulation.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock1Text2
data.value: When you sign up with us, you do agree that we may send you occasional emails such as newsletters, offers and information about new and updated products and services from us. You can opt out, i.e. unsubscribe, at any time by clicking the link provided for this in such emails.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock1Text3
data.value: During the installation and sign up procedure AxCrypt may contact one of our servers, if you allow it, and send us some minimal information.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock1Text4
data.value: This information is limited to:

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock1Text5
data.value: In addition to specific sign up information, when a device contacts a server of HTTP some information is always made available and we log this. This may include:

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock1Text6
data.value: We also log some additional specific events that are determined by the server access and internal procedures. This includes:

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock1Text7
data.value: All our servers are physically located in Sweden. We do not store any information created by the use of AxCrypt as described above anywhere else. For certain events, emails are generated, for example, non-delivery reports from your email provider or error logs. These emails may be sent to our staff who may be using commercial email service providers with international data centers.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock2ListItem1
data.value: Address

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock2ListItem2
data.value: VAT number (for EU customers)

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock2Text1
data.value: When creating an AxCrypt Business subscription, we do ask some additional information. This may include:

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock2Text2
data.value: We use this information to make VAT deduction possible for EU companies, and to display on invoices. This information is also managed within a third party Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock3Heading
data.value: Why do we need this information?

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock3Text1
data.value: It’s obvious why we need some of the information. We try to keep the amount of information logged and stored to a minimum, and we store no personal or sensitive information except your email address. Any confidential information you store on our servers is encrypted with your password, which we do not store or know, except briefly during the server interaction.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock3Text2
data.value: The other information is practical for us to see how and where AxCrypt is being used, so as to better prioritize development. It also to gives us a nice warm feeling seeing how much it’s being used!

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock3Text3
data.value: We also use the information logged to trace the events of usage when we receive and work with support requests. It has proven to be very helpful for us and improves the quality of support by for example seeing when last a successful sign in was made.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock3Text4
data.value: Our privacy policy may be updated from time to time without prior notice. Please check here for the currently valid policy. If you do not accept the new changes, we may not be able to provide you with the services you request.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock4Heading
data.value: Contact

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock4Text1
data.value: Should you have any specific questions about what we need a particular piece of information for, or if you want your data removed, please contact us at support@axcrypt.net

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock4Text2
data.value: If you are a Business users, and do not want to be included in our CRM system, please contact us at business@axcrypt.net

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock5Heading
data.value: Page and service functionality

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock5Text1
data.value: Cookies are used in the operation and presentation of data from websites. Such cookies may include language code information for the language selected by the user. It can be cookies with information that supports the load balancing of the system so that all users are guaranteed the best possible experience. For services that require login or search, cookies can be used that ensure that the service presents data to the right recipient.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock6Heading
data.value: Web analytics and cookies

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock6Text1
data.value: As an important part of the work of creating a user-friendly website, we look at the user pattern of those who visit the site. We analyze user behaviour to make the user experience better. The purpose of using cookies is therefore to improve the customer experience. To analyze the information, we use the analysis tool Google Analytics. Google Analytics uses cookies/cookies (small text files that the site stores on the user's computer), which records the user's IP address, and provides information about each user's online movement. Examples of what the statistics give us answers to are; how many people visit different pages, how long the visit lasts, which sites the users come from and which browsers are used. None of the cookies allows us to associate information about your use of the site with you as an individual. Cookie data is automatically deleted 14 months after registration. You can do it yourself and manage the use of cookies by adjusting settings on your browser. The information collected by Google Analytics is stored on Google's servers in the United States. Information received is subject to Google guidelines for Privacy. An IP address is defined as personal information because it can be traced back to a particular hardware and thus to an individual. We anonymize the user's IP address before the information is stored and processed by Google. Thus, the anonymized IP address cannot be used to identify the individual user. Your IP address is also logged for a short period by our web servers. The user's IP-address, time of day, website address, HTTP status, number of bytes sent, HTTP referrer and HTTP user agent is logged for 15 days. Beyond this point, the data is deleted.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock6Text2
data.value: If you understand, accept, and agree to the aforementioned policies, terms, and conditions outlined above, please click the Sign in button to proceed to your account. By proceeding, you acknowledge that your entered name will serve as your electronic signature to validate the consent. If you do not comprehend, accept, or agree to the aforementioned policies, terms, and conditions, then please do not click the Sign in button.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock7Heading
data.value: Search

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock7Text1
data.value: We store information about which keywords users use on our sites through Google Analytics. The purpose of the storage is to make our information offer better. The usage pattern for search is stored in aggregate form. Only the keyword is stored, and they cannot be linked to other user information such as IP addresses.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock8Heading
data.value: Forum / Share/tips-service

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock8Text1
data.value: The "Share with others'' features is voluntary and can be used to forward links to the site by email, or to share the content of social networking sites such as Facebook or Twitter. Information about tips is not logged with us but is only used there and then to post the tip of the social networking site. However, we cannot guarantee that the online community will not log this information. All such services should, therefore, be used wisely. You may contact the relevant service provider or online community to receive information about its collection, use, processing, and personal data protection. If you use the email feature, we only use the e-mail addresses given to forward the message without any form of storage.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock9Heading
data.value: Newsletter

data.name: PrivacyPolicyBlock9Text1
data.value: When you sign up with us, you do agree that we may send you occasional emails such as newsletters, offers and information about new and updated products and services from us. In order for us to be able to send an email, you must register an email address. The legal basis for processing for this purpose is consent, cf. GDPR Article 6, paragraph 1, letter a. This information is not shared with other businesses and is deleted when we are told that you no longer wish to receive information from us. You can opt-out, i.e. unsubscribe, at any time by clicking the link provided for this in such emails. HubSpot is our data processor for the newsletter.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock1Heading
data.value: How can AxCrypt help with the GDPR?

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock1Text1
data.value: The EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is a binding legislative act concerning the protection of personal data and individual rights. It was designed to harmonize data privacy laws across Europe, to protect and empower all EU citizens data privacy, and to reshape the way organizations approach data privacy.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock1Text2
data.value: The GDPR requires companies and organizations to implement reasonable ways to protect their data, such as encryption, to protect it against data loss or exposure. This is where AxCrypt can help.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock1Text3
data.value: As Recital 83 in the GDPR states: ”In order to maintain security and to prevent processing in infringement of this Regulation, the controller or processor should evaluate the risks inherent in the processing and implement measures to mitigate those risks, such as encryption.”

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock1Text4
data.value: You have to make sure that personal data is stored securely, whether on-premise or cloud-based, in order to prevent costly data breaches. Files that have been encrypted will be rendered useless when breached.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock1Text5
data.value: Below are some resources that can further inform you.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2Heading
data.value: Is AxCrypt HIPAA compliant?

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2ListItem1
data.value: Access Control/Encryption and Decryption – AES-128/AES-256

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2ListItem2
data.value: Integrity/Authentication – HMAC-SHA-512 Transmission

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2ListItem3
data.value: Security/Integrity Controls, Encryption AES-128/AES-256/HMAC-SHA-512

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2Text1
data.value: The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act protects the privacy and security of health information. Compliance of HIPAA only applies to organizations and processes. It does not apply to software, meaning that an encryption solution such as AxCrypt can’t be HIPAA compliant. Although, AxCrypt may suffice as (part of) a Technical Safeguard.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2Text2
data.value: The appropriate use of encryption and other Technical Safeguards is governed by the HIPAA Security Standards, 45 CFR 160, 162 and 164. The relevant section is 164.312 Technical Safeguards. No recommendations or requirements concerning specific encryption technologies are made there either, it’s specifically pointed out that the regulation is technology-neutral. It’s up to each and every organization to evaluate its position and risks, and then implement required or addressable specifications.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2Text3
data.value: You have to make sure that personal data is stored securely, whether on-premise or cloud-based, in order to prevent costly data breaches. Files that have been encrypted will be rendered useless when breached.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2Text4
data.value: Although the standard in no way refers to it except in comments, the CMS Internet Security Policy, which is the current view of Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services for their own use, does specify some minimal technology levels for certain cases. AxCrypt meets these requirements for transmission over the Internet – but your organization must independently evaluate if is sufficient to use the same level as the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2Text5
data.value: The parts where AxCrypt may (and should) suffice as (part of) a Technical Safeguard are:

data.name: RegulatoryComplianceBlock2Text6
data.value: The HIPAA Security Standard does allow the use of encryption as the basis for Access Control, that is to say to protect the privacy of data at rest (stored on a hard disk as opposed to traversing the Internet for example). AxCrypt will meet most organizations requirements here too.

data.name: RequirementsLinuxText
data.value: Other users have reported success running AxCrypt under Wine. However, it may be tricky to install since it requires dependencies to be manually installed, and the state of Mono (on which it depends) is very varying depending on the distribution.

data.name: RequirementsNoteText
data.value: AxCrypt runs on 32-bit and 64-bit versions of Windows. On Windows 8 and 10, AxCrypt works in desktop mode, but there is no Metro app available yet, nor does AxCrypt run on Windows RT. We recommend to user desktop viewers and editors to open files secured with AxCrypt, as the Metro apps sometimes cause various issues.

data.name: ResellerHelpAddAndManageCustomersBlock1Text1
data.value: To resell AxCrypt Business to a new customer, create their subscription on the account website:

data.name: ResellerHelpAddAndManageCustomersBlock1Text2
data.value:
Note: It will work both if your customer does or does not have a registered AxCrypt account.
They will receive an email or invite saying they have been added to a Business subscription. They must then activate their account.

data.name: ResellerHelpAddAndManageCustomersBlock1Text3
data.value:
You will automatically be added to their subscription as an administrator of their account.
Naturally, you will not be assigned a license.

data.name: ResellerHelpAddAndManageCustomersBlock1Text4
data.value: If you make any of your customer’s users an administrator, they will be able to purchase new licenses and manage the account. This means that you and they will not get the discount. We suggest not making them an administrator unless really needed.

data.name: ResellerHelpAddAndManageCustomersBlock1Text5
data.value: If any information has been filled in incorrectly during the creation, you can always change it by going to .

data.name: ResellerHelpAddAndManageCustomersBlock1Text6
data.value: This process is designed so it is completely managed by you and does not require any involvement from your customer (besides activating the account, should they not have an existing account yet), or from AxCrypt. If payment by bank transfer is preferred, this is possible too. See the billing tab for more information.

data.name: ResellerHelpAddAndManageCustomersBlock1Text7
data.value: AxCrypt offers one subscription for reselling: AxCrypt Business. You can use the sub menus on account.axcrypt.net to manage your existing clients or purchase licenses for your clients. Log in using the existing account that has been set as the admin.

data.name: SecureCloudFaq1
data.value: Why must you secure your cloud storage data?

data.name: SecureCloudFaq1Ans
data.value: While data uploaded onto the cloud can increase accessibility, it also increases the risk of exposure. </br></br>When you secure your data on the cloud with an encryption tool that deploys an AES-256 encryption algorithm. Only you and those to whom you give access via the application can access this encrypted data. </br></br>It's built for users who want to protect sensitive files, enable secure cloud file sharing, and encrypt documents online without disrupting workflow.

data.name: SecureCloudFaq2
data.value: How many cloud storage platforms does AxCrypt's Cloud Security support?

data.name: SecureCloudFaq2Ans
data.value: AxCrypt's Cloud Security supports only Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox.

data.name: SecureCloudFaq3
data.value: Can I securely share encrypted files stored in the cloud?

data.name: SecureCloudFaq3Ans
data.value: Yes. You can share encrypted files stored on the cloud through the Share Keys features present within the application. </br></br>With Cloud Security feature, you can grant access and authorize users. Your files remain protected through Cloud Security and are only accessible to approved or authorised users. </br></br>This cloud sync feature comes with maximum file protection and gives you complete control and security over your data.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText1
data.value: Log in to the application and choose the cloud service provider of your choice on the left.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText10
data.value: Click on 'Open Secured'.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText11
data.value: Please note: Your files stay encrypted and secure. They open briefly while you work and re-encrypt automatically when you exit the application.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText12
data.value: In the file selection pop-up, you can also secure files via the right-click menu—simply select your desired file and click Secure. Please note that a one-time cloud authorization is required.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText13
data.value: Click on 'Stop Securing'.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText14
data.value: Your files are now permanently decrypted.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText15
data.value: Please note: You can also click on the action menu (3 dots) in the bottom right corner and select stop secure.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText16
data.value: Sign in to AxCrypt and choose from the 3 cloud storage providers present.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText17
data.value: Locate your file and select it.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText18
data.value: Click on 'Share Keys'.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText19
data.value: Add the email ID you want to securely share keys with and click on 'Add'.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText2
data.value: A file selection pop-up will open showing the cloud files.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText20
data.value:
Cloud Security by AxCrypt is a feature that ensures encrypted cloud sync across multiple devices and supported cloud storage platforms. This allows you to secure cloud storage files using client-side encryption that authorises users with the necessary access permissions to access them.

With AxCrypt's Cloud Security feature, you can almost encrypt any files. From files, PDFs, sheets, to images, you can use AxCrypt's Cloud SecurityAES-256 encryption algorithm to protect them.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText21
data.value: Yes. Cloud Security by AxCrypt is designed as a zero-knowledge cloud storage solution. This means that your files are encrypted using the AES-256 encryption algorithm, and we do not hold or access any of the information or data that is uploaded onto the cloud storage platforms. The cloud storage provider does not control your encryption keys. This guarantees stronger data privacy and true end-to-end encrypted cloud sync.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText22
data.value: Locate the file from the available cloud storage options on the application.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText23
data.value: On the application homepage, click on your preferred cloud storage.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText24
data.value: Click the "+" action button and choose the file you want to securely upload to the cloud.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText25
data.value: Click Open, and the file is now encrypted in both locations : local and the cloud.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText26
data.value: Please note: The file will be encrypted locally as well as on the cloud.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText3
data.value: Select the file you want to protect.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText4
data.value: Click on the Action Menu (3 dots) in the bottom right corner of the popup.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText5
data.value: Click on Secure, and now your file is encrypted with an .axx extension.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText6
data.value: Please note: The file is encrypted locally and then uploaded to the cloud.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText7
data.value: Locate the file you want to Open Securely.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText8
data.value: Select the file and then right-click.

data.name: SecureCloudGuideStepText9
data.value: Or you may also click on the action menu (3 dots) to perform this action.

data.name: SecureCloudParagraph
data.value:
In this guide, you will learn how to use AxCrypt with cloud storage.
There's no need to install any cloud drive sync applications locally. AxCrypt Cloud Security encrypts your files with AES-256 and provides end-to-end protection, syncing them to the cloud while keeping them safe both in transit and during use.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq1
data.value: What is AxCrypt’s Secured Messenger?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq1Ans
data.value: Secured Messenger is an end-to-end encrypted messaging feature built into AxCrypt, allowing users to send private messages securely to any email address - no AxCrypt account required for the recipient. Non-AxCrypt users will receive an email for account creation in order to view the received encrypted message.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq2
data.value: How is Secured Messenger different from regular email?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq2Ans
data.value:
Unlike standard email, which can be intercepted or read by third parties, Secured Messenger encrypts your message content using AES-256 bit encryption before it leaves your device. Only
the intended recipient can decrypt and read it.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq3
data.value: Does the recipient need an AxCrypt account to read the message?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq3Ans
data.value: Yes. The recipient needs an AxCrypt account. They’ll receive an invite via email to create an account to view the encrypted message.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq4
data.value: How secured is your message? Can AxCrypt read it?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq4Ans
data.value:
No. AxCrypt follows a strict Zero-Knowledge policy. Your messages are encrypted on your device, and AxCrypt has no access to your password or decryption keys. Even AxCrypt cannot
access your message content.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq5
data.value: What encryption does Secured Messenger use?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq5Ans
data.value: Secured Messenger uses AES-256 encryption in CTR mode with a unique session key for each message. The session key is encrypted using a key derived from your password via PBKDF2-SHA512 and wrapped using NIST-approved AES Key Wrap.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq6
data.value: Can I control how long the message is available?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq6Ans
data.value: Yes. You can choose to make messages viewable once, set an expiration time, or allow them to be viewed indefinitely.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq7
data.value: Where is my message data stored?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq7Ans
data.value: Message data is stored completely encrypted on secure servers located in the EU, fully compliant with GDPR and NIS2 guidelines.

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq8
data.value: What happens to the message after it crosses its visibility limit?

data.name: SecuredMessengerFaq8Ans
data.value: Once a message exceeds its set visibility—whether it's a single view or time-based expiry—it becomes permanently inaccessible to the receiver.

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceHead1
data.value: Private, secure communication across devices

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceHead2
data.value: AES-256 encryption for complete confidentiality

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceHead3
data.value: Secure and Private Servers

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceHead4
data.value: Ephemeral Session Keys

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceText1
data.value: Send and receive end-to-end encrypted messages from any device, with full control over how long each message remains visible - once, timed, or forever.

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceText2
data.value: Messages are encrypted using AES-256-bit encryption in Counter (CTR) mode with a unique, randomly generated Initialization Vector (IV) for every message. This ensures even repeated messages look completely different when encrypted.

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceText3
data.value: AxCrypt’s Secured Messenger operates on servers located in the EU, fully compliant with stringent GDPR regulations and NIS2 cybersecurity standards.

data.name: SecuredMessengerGlanceText4
data.value: Key wrapping of the message is done using the NIST specification for AES Key Wrap. The key derived from the message with PBKDF2-SHA512 is only used as a key encrypting key.

data.name: SecuredMessengerGuidesNote
data.value: AxCrypt provides strong encryption without any backdoors. If you forget your password, your encrypted messages will remain inaccessible. Since they are locked with your original password and we do not store or have access to it, we cannot help recover or decrypt your files.

data.name: SecuredMessengerLinkLabel
data.value: Secured Messenger

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec1Heading
data.value: What is AxCrypt’s Secured Messenger?

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec1Text1
data.value: Secured Messenger is a secure, end-to-end encrypted messaging feature built into AxCrypt. It allows you to send private messages to any email address using AES-256 encryption, ensuring that only the intended recipient can read the content - no matter which device they’re on.

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec1Text2
data.value: The Secured Messenger can be accessed from any web browser or through AxCrypt’s Desktop and mobile apps as well. Messages remain encrypted using 256-bit symmetric encryption, even when synced across devices. All data in-transit is further protected with Transport Layer Security (TLS), ensuring end-to-end privacy during transmission.

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec2Heading
data.value: AxCrypt’s Secured Messenger at a Glance

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Heading
data.value: How Do We Secure Your Messages?

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Text1
data.value:
AxCrypt’s Secured Messenger encrypts every message using your account password, which is never stored on your device or our
servers - ensuring that only you and the intended recipient can access the content.

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Text2
data.value: We use the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with 256-bit keys in Counter (CTR) mode, along with a unique, random Initialization Vector (IV) for each message. This ensures maximum confidentiality and prevents pattern detection.

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Text3
data.value:
Each message is encrypted with a newly generated 256-bit session key. This session key is then securely wrapped using AES Key Wrap, following NIST specifications. The wrapping key is derived from your password using PBKDF2 with SHA-512, and is used solely for
encrypting the session key - not the message itself.

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Text4
data.value: In practice, here’s how it works:

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Text5
data.value: Encryption: The message is encrypted with a random session key using AES-256. This session key is then encrypted with your password and attached to the message.

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Text6
data.value: Decryption: When the recipient opens the message, their password is used to decrypt the session key, which is then used to decrypt the message content.

data.name: SecuredMessengerSec3Text7
data.value: This layered approach ensures that your messages are always secure - both in transit and at rest.

data.name: SecuredMessengerText
data.value: Ensure private, secure communication across devices with AES-256 encryption for intended recipients.

data.name: SecurityBlock1Heading
data.value: Why is AxCrypt secure?

data.name: SecurityBlock1Text
data.value: AxCrypt is secure because it endeavors to only use accepted practices and algorithms and does not attempt to invent any new encryption algorithms or methods. It’s also open source; Anyone may inspect the source code, check it for errors, omissions or back doors. It has been used and inspected for vulnerabilities for over 15 years and tried by more than 30 million users, without any known weaknesses.

data.name: SecurityBlock2Heading
data.value: How secure is AxCrypt?

data.name: SecurityBlock2Text
data.value: This question breaks down to effective encryption key lengths. The key length used is 128 or 256 bits – exhaustive search is not currently believed to be an option in either case and it is computationally infeasible in cryptographic terms. The problem lies with the passwords used – this is the weak point. You can read more about what to consider when choosing a password below.

data.name: SecurityBlock3Heading
data.value: Password considerations

data.name: SecurityBlock3ListItem1
data.value: The name of the file, as well as the size, may be recovered.

data.name: SecurityBlock3ListItem2
data.value: If the file has been viewed or edited with an application that creates temporary copies of the content (such as Microsoft Office), those temporary copies may still be available for undeletion on your hard disk.

data.name: SecurityBlock3Text1
data.value: AxCrypt uses AES-128 or AES-256 in the Premium version – but if you want to achieve that level of security you must give it 128 or 256 bits of truly ‘random’ data. This is very hard to do, but the easiest way to even approach this is to use the password generator included in Premium.

data.name: SecurityBlock3Text2
data.value: To actually get 128 or 256 bits, you’ll in practice have to save this password in a text file, and then keep that text file very secret.Using typical English language in a password, 128 bits is approximately equivalent to 10 ‘random’ words, and 256 bits thus twice this. Do not use meaningful sentences and absolutely not famous or even obscure quotations!By introducing variations on the case, as well as non-alphabetic characters you can reduce the number of words necessary. It’s not recommended to use less than 5 words. If you use a completely random selection of upper and lower-case letters and digits, you need 22 characters to achieve 128 bits security, and thus 44 characters for 256 bits. (The above is a slight simplification of the issue, but it should serve.)The shredding, or wiping, feature of AxCrypt allows you to erase files in a way that makes it impossible to recover the contents with undeletion software. However, there are some caveats:

data.name: SecurityBlock3Text3
data.value: See the section on local PC security for tips on how to increase your security margin for these matters.

data.name: SecurityBlock4Heading
data.value: Local PC Security

data.name: SecurityBlock4List1Item1
data.value: Your applications maintaining clear text in memory, which subsequently is placed in the paging file.

data.name: SecurityBlock4List1Item2
data.value: Your applications creating temporary files, which are not properly wiped.

data.name: SecurityBlock4List1Item3
data.value: Deep reading of overwritten hard-disk data with custom software and laboratory equipment.

data.name: SecurityBlock4List2Item1
data.value: Untimely power cycling of your computer and subsequent cryptanalysis.

data.name: SecurityBlock4List2Item2
data.value: Keyboard-sniffers, either in hardware or software.

data.name: SecurityBlock4List3Item1
data.value: Strong passwords, either with AxCrypt or your sign in.

data.name: SecurityBlock4List3Item2
data.value: Password-protected screen savers.

data.name: SecurityBlock4Text1
data.value: AxCrypt by itself will not protect your local PC from, for example:

data.name: SecurityBlock4Text2
data.value: Data exposure due to:

data.name: SecurityBlock4Text3
data.value: Password exposure due to:

data.name: SecurityBlock4Text4
data.value: Neglect to use:

data.name: SecurityBlock5Heading
data.value: Account Keys

data.name: SecurityBlock5Text1
data.value: An account key is what enables the implementation of various new rich features, such as allowing other team members to open secured files with their own passwords. In technical terms, an AxCrypt Account key consists of a public key pair composed of a public (non-secret) and a private (secret) part and some other meta data.

data.name: SecurityBlock5Text2
data.value: The account key is always kept secured with your password as well, although one part of it is not secret and is used when securing files for you and your team. For you, the benefit is that you can change the password for all files in one single operation. For your team members, the benefit is that you and your team can allow each other to open secured files without sharing passwords by just specifying the email address of the other member.

data.name: SecurityBlock5Text3
data.value: Anyone can use your email address to allow you to open a secured file with your own passphrase, and you can allow anyone with an email address to open a file secured by you. All this is enabled by the public part of the account key being available on our server.

data.name: SecurityBlock6Heading
data.value: Algorithms

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text1
data.value: The cryptological primitives are AES-128 or AES-256 for bulk encryption, PBKDF2 with HMAC-512 for key deriviation, 4096-bit RSA for the account key, and HMAC-512 for integrity checking.

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text2
data.value: The algorithms used are deemed secure as such, to the best of our knowledge, by the US Government and the Internet community. Please see the documents package and the source code for details.

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text3
data.value: Key wrapping of the password is done using the NIST specification for AES Key Wrap. The key derived from the password with PBKDF2-SHA512 is only used as a key encrypting key.

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text4
data.value: As a brute force counter measure, key wrapping is done with at least 5 000 iterations, increasing the work effort with approximately 12 bits. The actual iteration count is determined dynamically, a typical value is 25 000 to 100 000, adding 14-17 bits of effective key-length. The faster machine you install AxCrypt on – the better the security!

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text5
data.value: AxCrypt uses the Advanced Encryption Standard with 128-bit or 256-bit keys in Counter mode with a ‘random’ IV for the data encryption.

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text6
data.value: For integrity verification AxCrypt uses HMAC-SHA512, i.e. Hash Message Authentication Code using SHA-512 with 512-bit output.

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text7
data.value: The pseudo random number generator (PRNG) used is primarily the operating system provided one, in some cases with added entropy added.

data.name: SecurityBlock6Text8
data.value: There may well be bugs in our implementation though – that is why it’s open source, so you and our peers may review it and keep it safe. This should not be taken as a low level of confidence in our code – anyone who tells you their code is flawless is either inexperienced or lying.

data.name: SecurityBlock7Heading
data.value: Is AxCrypt HIPAA compliant?

data.name: SecurityBlock7ListItem1
data.value: Access Control/Encryption and Decryption – AES-128/AES-256

data.name: SecurityBlock7ListItem2
data.value: Integrity/Authentication – HMAC-SHA-512 Transmission

data.name: SecurityBlock7ListItem3
data.value: Security/Integrity Controls, Encryption AES-128/AES-256/HMAC-SHA-512

data.name: SecurityBlock7Text1
data.value: There is no such thing as HIPAA compliant software. Only organizations and procedures can be HIPAA compliant.

data.name: SecurityBlock7Text2
data.value: The appropriate use of encryption and other Technical Safeguards is governed by the HIPAA Security Standards, 45 CFR 160, 162 and 164. The relevant section is 164.312 Technical Safeguards. No recommendations or requirements concerning specific encryption technologies are made there either, it’s specifically pointed out that the regulation is technology-neutral. It’s up to each and every organization to evaluate its position and risks, and then implement required or addressable specifications.

data.name: SecurityBlock7Text3
data.value: Although the standard in no way refers to it except in comments, the CMS Internet Security Policy, which is the current view of Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services for their own use, does specify some minimal technology levels for certain cases. AxCrypt meets these requirements for transmission over the Internet – but your organization must independently evaluate if is sufficient to use the same level as the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.

data.name: SecurityBlock7Text4
data.value: The parts where AxCrypt may (and should) suffice as (part of) a Technical Safeguard are:

data.name: SecurityBlock7Text5
data.value: The HIPAA Security Standard does allow the use of encryption as the basis for Access Control, that is to say to protect the privacy of data at rest (stored on a hard disk as opposed to traversing the Internet for example). AxCrypt will meet most organizations requirements here too.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsDescription
data.value: This section describes in detail just what AxCrypt is, what it does, and how it does it. It is mostly for technical experts, who have a good grasp on software development as well as cryptography. Information here is intended to be complete enough to build AxCrypt-compatible software for example.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsLinkLabel
data.value: Technical Details

data.name: TechnicalDetailsSourceCodeHeading
data.value: Source code

data.name: TechnicalDetailsSourceCodeText
data.value: The complete source code for the core libraries and the Windows client used to be in a mercurial repository in Bitbucket. But as of summer 2020, Bitbucket discontinued their mercurial support and we’re actively working on finding an alternative solution to make the source code easily available. For now, please contact support@axcrypt.net and we will supply the source code.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerHeading
data.value: What is stored on the server?

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerListText1
data.value: The email address of the account.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerListText2
data.value: The sign in status, number of failed sign in attempts, last time of sign in etc.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerListText3
data.value: The payment status.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerListText4
data.value: A RSA-4096 public key that is available for others to download in order to perform file key sharing.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerListText5
data.value: One or more RSA-4096 private keys, encrypted using AxCrypt and the sign in password, so we can keep it synchronized across devices, and as a backup should a device be lost or destroyed.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerText1
data.value: When an account is created, we store some basic information.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerText2
data.value: If the password manager is used, we also store an AES-256 XML-encrypted file with the password records, encrypted with the sign in password.

data.name: TechnicalDetailsStoredOnServerText3
data.value: Apart from the above, we perform some logging that helps us monitor the infrastructure, and improve our support capabilities. This is detailed at privacy policy.

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock11Text1
data.value: We offer 14 days free trial for the AxCrypt Premium or Business plan for new users. If you don’t like the product you can cancel the subscription before the trial ends. Cancelling the subscription can be done at any time. Doing this will not affect the trial and you will still be able to use all the features that comes with Business, Premium subscription during your trial period. After the 14 days of free trial, we will charge your credit/debit cards if you haven’t cancelled your subscription.

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock12Heading
data.value: Payment and renewal

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock12Text1
data.value: We will provide Premium, Password Manager or Business plan services after receiving payment. Your payment details are never sent to or stored on our servers. Your paid subscription will automatically renew at the end of the subscription period, using the initial payment method. If you want to cancel, you must do so before the end of the current subscription period. You will be downgraded to Free or Viewer version as appropriate after the last day of your current subscription period.

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock12Text2
data.value: We may change the price of our paid subscriptions at any time, but it will not affect your current subscription period. Price changes will take effect at the start of your next subscription period. You accept the new price by continuing to use your paid subscription after the price change takes effect, or decline it by cancelling before it takes effect.

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock12Text3
data.value: Cancelling your paid subscription may be done at any time. However, refunds are not offered. For trying out AxCrypt to see if it fits your needs, you get a 14 days at the start of your initial subscription.

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock13Text1

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock14Text1
data.value: We will not disclose any information about you to any third parties without your explicit consent, unless required by law.

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock15Heading
data.value: Disclosure to authorities and law enforcement

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock15Text1
data.value: In theory, we may be forced by law to disclose information to government authorities. If required by law, we will comply. Such information is by definition limited to what we actually have, i.e. statistics, access logs and encrypted private keys and password manager data. We do not know your password, nor do we know what information you have encrypted, and thus cannot disclose this even if required by law.

data.name: TermsOfUseBlock15Text2
data.value: It is our belief, although it is probably not tested in the legal system, that we cannot be forced to reprogram AxCrypt in a way that would make it possible to intercept your passwords to disclose your information. If this would happen then, we will do our best within our legal rights to make this known, possibly by shutting down the service as a last resort.

data.name: TextEncryptionAdvancedProtectionFeatures
data.value: Encrypt your text securely with advanced protection features.

data.name: TextEncryptionEmailBodyText
data.value: This text is encrypted — use AxCrypt to view the original message.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq2
data.value: Is there a character limit for encrypting text?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq2Ans
data.value: Yes, the input text field supports up to 1000 characters.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq3
data.value: Do I need a password to encrypt text?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq3Ans
data.value: No, encryption happens automatically. However, if a custom password has been set by the sender, you will need it to decrypt the text.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq4
data.value: How do I share the encrypted text?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq4Ans
data.value: You can share it using the Copy button, Download as .TXT, or Send via Email options provided.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq5
data.value: Is the encrypted text safe to send over email or chat apps?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq5Ans
data.value: Yes. The encryption ensures that even if someone intercepts the message, they cannot read it without the password.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq6
data.value: Can I edit encrypted text?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq6Ans
data.value: No, encrypted text cannot be edited. If you need changes, edit the original text and encrypt it again.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq7
data.value: Which encryption algorithm is used for text encryption in AxCrypt?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq7Ans
data.value: AxCrypt uses industry-standard AES-256 encryption, ensuring strong protection for your text. This is the same level of encryption used by government and enterprise-grade security systems.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq8
data.value: Does text encryption happen locally on my device or on the cloud?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq8Ans
data.value: All text encryption and decryption processes occur locally on your device. Your text is never uploaded to any server, ensuring complete privacy and control over your data.

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq9
data.value: What happens if I forget my password?

data.name: TextEncryptionFaq9Ans
data.value: AxCrypt cannot recover or reset your password because we do not have access to it. To avoid losing access, we recommend storing your password securely in a trusted password manager.

data.value: Send via email

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideshareHead4
data.value: Share as a Secure Link

data.name: TextEncryptionGuidesHeadParagraph
data.value: AxCrypt lets you encrypt plain text in seconds. Simply enter the text, secure it with your account password or a custom password, and share the encrypted output via email, private messages, and more.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuidesHeadTitle
data.value: Text Encryption, Sharing and Decryption Guide

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepHead1
data.value: Encrypting Text on Desktop

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepHead2
data.value: 4 Easy Ways to share Encrypted text

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepHead3
data.value: Decrypting Text on Desktop

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText1
data.value: Open the AxCrypt App on your Desktop.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText10
data.value: From the menu, select Text Decryption.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText11
data.value: Click Decrypt Text.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText12
data.value: Enter your Encrypted text in the input field below.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText13
data.value: Your encrypted text will be decrypted, and the original text will be displayed below.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText14
data.value: Important Notes:

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText15
data.value: Click Decrypt

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText16
data.value: Click Encrypt

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText17
data.value:
Use Share as Link to generate a secure, time-limited link to your encrypted text.
Choose whether the link can be accessed by Anyone or only Specific users (New users will receive an invitation email, and after the file is shared, a notification email with the access link).
Add up to 3 specific email addresses for restricted access

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText18
data.value: Set an expiration time (for example, 1 hour)

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText19
data.value: Share the link confidently, knowing access is controlled and temporary

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText2
data.value: From the menu, select Text Encryption.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText20
data.value: This option is ideal when you want secure sharing without sending files or copying long encrypted text blocks.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText21
data.value: If the encrypted text was shared using the Anyone option, you must enter the custom password provided by the sender to decrypt the content.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText22
data.value: If the text was shared with you as a Specific user, no password is required, you can decrypt the content directly using the secure link.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText3
data.value: Click Encrypt Text.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText4
data.value: Enter your text in the input field below (up to 1000 characters).

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText5
data.value: Your encrypted text will be generated and displayed below.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText6
data.value: Note: You can opt for a custom password that is strong & easy to remember, to encrypt & decrypt this text.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText7
data.value: Click the Copy button to instantly copy the encrypted text to your clipboard. You can then paste it into any app or platform such as messaging apps, documents, or chat windows for quick and easy sharing.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText8
data.value: Select the Download as .TXT option to save the encrypted text as a .txt file on your device. This file can be shared through email, cloud storage, messaging platforms, or any other method you prefer.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideStepText9
data.value: Choose Send via Email to share the encrypted text directly through email. This option provides a simple alternative to traditional email encryption by automatically inserting the encrypted content for you.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideTips1
data.value: 🔐 Keep your password secure: Share it only with intended recipients and avoid sending it through insecure channels.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideTips2
data.value: 📝 Double-check your text: Ensure your input is accurate before encrypting, since encrypted text cannot be edited.

data.name: TextEncryptionGuideTips3
data.value: 🛡️ Custom Password: Store your password safely (password manager recommended). AxCrypt cannot recover or reset it for you, as we never have access to your password.

data.name: TSTMNL_1
data.value: This would be the first time we are reviewing a product or the service way before purchasing it. Rittik, the guy who conducted the demo, has excellent knowledge about his product & he had all the answers just like that in split seconds. For our institute work, we purchase & take multiple demos, but this is the best so far.

data.name: TSTMNL_2
data.value: I had a special request, and the support team responded almost immediately. The solution was explained clearly, worked perfectly, and the follow-up response was just as fast. Their responsiveness is genuinely impressive it feels like help is always available. AxCrypt is a great company with a highly responsive team, which is rare to find today.

data.name: TSTMNL_3
data.value: I ran into some challenges while converting a user account to a business account, but the support team was excellent and resolved everything quickly and smoothly.

data.name: TSTMNL_4
data.value: I've been using the product for a couple of months now. From implementation to daily use, any questions I've had were answered promptly with clear, helpful instructions. My only regret is not discovering it sooner.

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_BSALP_Text3
data.value: Our customers outsource the installation and operation of their IT environment to us. It is therefore extremely important that this information is protected in the best possible way and with the most up-to-date methods. AxCrypt helps us to work with a high level of protection but still in a simple and efficient way.

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_DCDCIST_Text6
data.value: Nous avions non seulement un besoin interne, mais nous cherchions également une solution solide pour nos clients afin de protéger nos données en les chiffrant, les rendant ainsi inutilisables en cas de vol. epuis de longues années, nous utilisions la version gratuite d'AxCrypt, ce qui nous a décidés à passer à la version payante est la possibilité d'utiliser AxCrypt en réseau, c'est-à-dire d'accéder à plusieurs à nos données toutes en les gardant chiffrées. Nous avons déjà chiffré toutes nos données administratives, nous allons maintenant chiffrer toutes nos données techniques. Nous sommes satisfaits d'avoir choisi AxCrypt comme solution de chiffrement, car de plus son tarif est très correct en rapport à la sécurité apporté !

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_DLHISG_Text5
data.value: AxCrypt is a very easy to use and user friendly encryption software that helps us to encrypt our sensitive files and folders thereby achieving regulatory compliance.

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_DPCVBA_Text1
data.value: Top solution. There [is] some sensitive information (personnel files, board information) [that] needs to be better protected within the organization. AxCrypt allows [us] to transfer this type of sensitive information by e-mail and to store this information on company drives. Once installed, AxCrypt is perfectly usable for all stakeholders involved. Different security groups (HR/Board/...) could be created.

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_DPECN_Text11
data.value: I have been using AxCrypt for many years, it gives me peace of mind that sensitive information is protected, and that when we delete any information that is no longer required, it is done in a secure and reliable way. The product integrates very well and becomes an easy to use extension of the operating system.!

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_DPECN_Text9
data.value: AxCrypt has been wonderful for meeting all of the encryption needs of my small business. As a company working in the mental healthcare space, data safety and security are of paramount importance to us, and we have found AxCrypt's product to be a powerful and effective yet user-friendly solution. !

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_EDTDIPTSAS_Text2
data.value: We were seduced by the ergonomics of the product and its ease of use. It helped us to secure (encrypt) our important and confidential documents. The key sharing functions allow us to share the decryption with other accounts easily. The business version allows a very simple and practical management of accounts and licenses

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_IACSCA_Text10
data.value: AxCrypt allows me to protect any type of file (without the obligation of specific formats even in the storage of passwords) in a simple and safe way and to access my data from any device. but above all I can only share the data access keys with my team and not the entire file or copies of data.!

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_JSMM_Text8
data.value: We were looking for a way to store backups of sensitive financial data with one of our cloud providers and not risk exposure to their employees or outside forces. We decided that encrypting the backups before moving them to the cloud platform would solve that problem. However, the encryption process needed to be simple and easy to do or it would not be done. Furthermore, we wanted a safety net in case that person left the company and left us with encrypted files. AxCrypt provided an encryption solution that is super easy to use, and with the company account, we can implement a master key which will allow IT to decrypt any files in case of problems arising from users leaving encrypted files or forgetting passwords. Our financial person now happily goes about her job without having to wrestle with an onerous encryption process to provide the needed security. !

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_JTJT_Text7
data.value: My translation agencies require me to encrypt all documents (source and translation). AxCrypt provides a convenient, user-friendly way to do this. !

data.name: TSTMNL_Business_WREGNSA_Text4
data.value: We were looking for a simple encryption tool that we could roll out to our users without having to provide a lot of training. AxCrypt just did that for us. Outside of an initial \"how to\" document that I typed up in about a few minutes, I don’t have to provide much support to the users. AxCrypt makes that so easy.

data.name: TSTMNL_Home_GreenGeeks_Text4
data.value: .. as far as overall paid services go, you will be hard-pressed to find anything better.

data.name: TSTMNL_Home_PCMag_Text1
data.value: AxCrypt Premium makes encryption simple enough for any user, and it even offers public key cryptography for secure sharing of encrypted files.

data.name: TSTMNL_Home_TechDogs_Text5
data.value: A handy and easy-to-use file encryption and folder encryption tool, Axcrypt works for android, Windows and iOs.

data.name: TSTMNL_Home_TechRader_Text2
data.value: AxCrypt’s plainclothes approach makes encrypting files a breeze.

data.name: TSTMNL_Home_TechRader_Text3
data.value: AxCrypt is an inexpensive and effective encryption tool .. you’re in for a cheap and worthwhile file encryption software.

data.name: TSTMNL_Home_TechRader_Text6
data.value: …AxCrypt is quite easy to use. It is also available in 13 languages which is really good for a lot of my students because many of them have English as a second language and they also need to work with a lot of people all over the globe…

data.name: TSTMNL_Industries_ESFCIC_Text3
data.value: Encryption works. Properly implemented strong crypto systems are one of the few things that you can rely on.

data.name: TSTMNL_Industries_PCMAGBEES_Text4
data.value: AxCrypt makes everything about encryption simple, so you shouldn’t be surprised to learn that it even makes PKI exchange of secure data simple(…) For these reasons, AxCrypt joins CertainSafe as an Editors’ Choice for encryption.

data.name: TSTMNL_Industries_TCA_Text2
data.value: Without encryption, you and I wouldn't be able to do our banking online. We wouldn't be able to buy things online, because your credit cards - they've probably been ripped off anyway, but they would be ripped off left and right every day if there wasn't encryption.
